summary: Final update, validated (valid; effects: knowledge statement update on 2b0dd5bd, question hypothesis/discriminator update, interpretation append with rationale, counterevidence and limitations). It closes the last axis the account still listed as open for question 0757162a by counting rather than by a new run: once the recovery dispatch consumes the leader bookkeeping, the replies that can still arrive number N - SlowQuorumSize, which is smaller than SlowQuorumSize for every N, so a second dispatch on the fresh bookkeeping that startPhase1 installs is unreachable in this path - for N=5, two replies against a threshold of three. The measured half of the argument is already in the four-order receipt, where the fresh bookkeeping held zero appended replies immediately after the trigger and then one and two as the two remaining replies landed in it, with no further dispatch and the instance unchanged; so the empty-command adoption is final once the trigger fires, and the reply adopted at that position is the whole decision procedure for this reply set. The behaviour entry gained that statement (with the counting argument, the measured appended counts and the note that it is a counted absence rather than an executed one), a counterevidence item records that no run drives a second dispatch because none can, a limitation marks the argument as source-derived, and the question's discriminator now reads as closed for both the delivery-order half (all six permutations of the three-reply set and four orders of the two-carrier/two-empty set), the reply-count half (more command-carrying replies do not flip the outcome) and the post-trigger half, with the neighbouring lower-value-ballot axis left to the separate recovery-value question that already measured it. Earlier this turn the two resolved gap explanations were restored on the live interpretation. State of the audit: six questions with explained dispositions; four asserted recovery-value defects (fabricated self ballot, lower-ballot replies ignored, status-guard stall cleared only by the retry, empty-slice replacement decided by the trigger position), one holding contract (client re-offer for the single-NOOP case), one refuted reachability claim (the wrong-row write in handlePreAccept), all on executed receipts with the captured snapshot untouched.
